messages:
Liam (sales): Heads-up — Glacier wants a POC using their in-house model borealis-35b-rlhf. They asked if Redwood can host it and also serve on Dedicated. Need timeline and rough pricing for their deck.
Sofia (solutions): Quick clarifying q's: artifact format (hf/pt/ggml), tokenizer type, max_seq_len, expected concurrency pattern, and whether they need KV persistence across requests?
Liam (sales): They shared a PyTorch .pt checkpoint + bpe.json tokenizer. Max seq len 4096. Traffic: baseline 50 concurrent, spikes to 200 for short windows, avg reply ~350 tokens, ~250k requests/day.
Marta (product): Catalog fit notes: we'll map this to our 35B performance band but need compatibility checks before publishing. Important to know embedding/rope style (roPE vs ALiBi) and whether they used custom attention layers.
Ravi (eng-ml): Runtime checklist:
- Confirm causal transformer archetype -> looks like it from their config
- Verify rotary vs sin/cos positional encoding (affects kernel selection)
- Single-file weights or sharded?
- Dtype (fp32/fp16) -> influences quant path (q4_K / q8_0)
If they provide fp32 we can try q4_K; will run quality regressions on client prompts.
Sofia (solutions): Timeline estimates: smoke compatibility run in staging if artifacts arrive within 48 hours -> 2 business days. Full perf + cost profile on hosted -> 5 business days. Dedicated onboarding (capacity + contracts) -> add ~10 business days.
Liam (sales): They asked for a one-line pricing estimate to include in their internal deck — any safe ballpark we can give?
Marta (product): Ballpark: map tokens to our 35B hosted per-token band. Say X tokens/day -> estimate = tokens * hosted_rate_35B. For reserved, give a commit-level $/month tied to expected peak qps and throughput; I'll compute with assumptions and send a spreadsheet.
Noah (security): Enterprise blockers to flag now: model license and copyright statements, training data provenance, any third-party datasets with restricted use, artifact signing (SHA256), and dependency SCA. For Private deployments we need KMS/HSM details and compliance docs (SOC2/ISO). Ask them for a security contact.
Ravi (eng-ml): Action items for the customer: send a tiny test bundle (model slice or distilled 100M-param subset OR full state_dict + tokenizer + model config) and a sample prompt set (10-20 prompts) for quality checks and tokenization parity. Also include a small set of long-context tests (3500-4000 tokens).
Sofia (solutions): I'll share the onboarding checklist + upload endpoint. Example curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://upload.redwood.ai/models -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -F "model=@borealis-35b-rlhf.pt" -F "tokenizer=@bpe.json" -F "metadata=@manifest.json"
```
Liam (sales): Can we commit to the 2-business-day smoke run if they drop artifacts by EOD tomorrow? They want demo-ready results for next week's exec review.
Ravi (eng-ml): Yes, if artifacts arrive by EOD tomorrow we can queue compatibility smoke. Need full checkpoint + tokenizer + 10 sample prompts.
Marta (product): Catalog variants plan: publish two entries in staging: borealis-35b-rlhf (fp16-hosted profile) and borealis-35b-rlhf-q4 (quantized candidate). Also prepare a smaller fallback: borealis-7b-slim for routing policy.
Sofia (solutions): Compatibility tests we'll run: model-load, forward pass (1-token and long-seq), KV cache save/restore, batch inference, streaming behaviour, tokenization parity, deterministic outputs check. Failure modes -> remediation: repackage weights, provide converter script, or recommend retrain patch.
Noah (security): I'll upload a tailored questionnaire and mark required docs: license file, training-data-notes.md, artifact checksum, and contact for legal/security. If they want Dedicated/Private, we need SSO metadata and KMS integration details early.
UploadBot: Upload endpoint created: https://upload.redwood.ai/models (expires in 72h) :white_check_mark:
Liam (sales): I'll send the intro email to Glacier now with the checklist and copy the owners. Assigning: Sofia = POC lead, Ravi = runtime validation, Marta = catalog/profile + pricing calc, Noah = security questionnaire. Thanks team :pray:
